notes.title: K.O.M.A Update Notes - Version 1.2 [Added Smooth Locomotion]
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34608743/3cc467f9630fb9e5bb00eec15835bd1b1fcff903.jpg
Hello everyone!


We just pushed out a new update based on the feedback you have shared with us, and included some game improvements as well:

 Added Smooth Locomotion
 Added New Steam Achievements
 Added New Hints
 Added New Settings/Features
 Added New Sounds and Elements 
 Bug Fixes 


Special Instruction Notes for Oculus Rift Users: 

 Before using  Smooth Locomotion,  first choose between two options: Righ-hand or Left-hand control.  Use one hand thumb-stick to move, while other thumb-stick to turn left or right. 
 Press Y or B button to wake up. 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34608743/f06e2ef4e821d4cc87b863403039f41a3ec1382a.jpg

We monitor all channels for new issues and feedback, so we can improve and evolve with your help.
- Thanks, team ENNO
